title: 百人まとめて、来い
reward: 百人戦の優勝と帰還門の鍵

scenes.name: 百人戦の規則
scenes.purpose: 大勢の強さと勝ち方の条件を先に示す

panels.art: Wide tall martial arena stair down into circular stone ring. Yun and So Rin stand on entry steps, one sheathed sword at left hip; many adult opponents in blue green brown robes below. Poster no writing.
panels.speaker: 司会
panels.text: 場外に落ちた者から、敗退！

panels.art: Close one arrogant male champion 30s muscular high black topknot dark green robes holds ONE heavy spear; Yun at opposite edge wary.
panels.speaker: 槍の王

panels.art: Yun grips scabbard but does NOT draw sword, eyes on ring boundary and nervous spectator family behind railing.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 刃を向けたら、人に当たる。

panels.art: Yun steps into ring unarmed with both hands open, sheathed sword visible, determined but breath tense.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 百人、まとめて来てくれ。

scenes.name: 足が着く前に
scenes.purpose: 飛燕歩と力加減で簡単かつ非致死の勝利

panels.art: Opponents rush inward, spear champion thrusts at Yun's torso. Yun bends lightly aside, body motion clear, doesn't draw sword. No victory yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 当てるのは、人じゃない。

panels.art: Yun uses cyan footsteps to run DOWN ring edge then leap lightly, one left hand touches stone floor as gust starts. Sword remains sheathed. Large motion shot, no duplicate bodies.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Controlled circular upward air pulse lifts weapons and opponents over ring boundary onto soft awnings/outside sand. No impalements, no falls from heights, spectators protected. Champion lands seated in sand holding unbroken spear.
panels.speaker: 槍の王

panels.art: Yun standing alone in ring, exhales and looks around to confirm safety, arms relaxed. Crowd astonished, So Rin smiles small.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: みんな、着地できたよな。

scenes.name: 画面の向こうの敵
scenes.purpose: 勝利の快感からゲームにない存在の謎へ

panels.art: Judge gives Yun ONE palm-sized bronze circular gate key and small purse of gold. Smith beside him. Key is round bronze disk with center hole, not sword.
panels.speaker: 司会
panels.text: 優勝！　帰還門の鍵を授ける！

panels.art: CYAN translucent hologram in Yun's vision reading exactly: 称号　百人の統率者. Yun amazed, not greedy.
panels.speaker: システム
panels.text: 称号　百人の統率者
system: 称号　百人の統率者

panels.art: Yun looks up toward shaded spectator stairs as a lone white-haired man in slate-blue robes stands watching. White-haired man is Hakujin, gold eyes, BLACK cracked seal on RIGHT wrist. No hostile attack.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun shocked, brief reflected silhouette of game final-boss sword battle WITHOUT depicting new actual fight. Hakujin visible at far lower stair.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 俺が、最後に倒した敵だ。

scenes.name: 落ちる先を見る
scenes.purpose: 挑発から大技へ飛ばず、傷つけない勝ち方を足場と退路から組み立てる

panels.art: BEFORE any arena attack: Yun with ONE sword SHEATHED studies the arena edge and the broad sand landing zone below. Opponents hold position, no one falling.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun's shoe gently tests an existing seam in arena stone. No shockwave, no cracks propagating yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun raises one OPEN hand to warn the spear king and nearby opponents, not casting a spell yet. Opponents alert, safe distance from spectators.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun sees opponents brace knees and loosen grips, then lowers his shoulders with focus. His sword remains SHEATHED. Victory and falling bodies not visible yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
